method_note: Comp: sentence contains one of than/unlike/compared to/rather than/instead of/whereas. Sib: sentence contains the name of another class in the benchmark; matching is case-insensitive with hyphens and underscores read as spaces; substring matching against pool class names, each sentence credited to its own class. All rates recomputed 2026-10-10 under this single documented protocol (the earlier Sib column used an unrecoverable ad-hoc variant and contained at least one impossible value: attr/Aircraft 9.2 vs 0/2000 actual).
